edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value to its callers.
Constructor consumes _msgSender() output as the mint target and role holder.
The caller-supplied msg.sender is the privileged beneficiary of the initial mint.
Constructor amount flows directly into the _mint balance and supply additions.
Constructor decimals argument is written to the token decimals state.
Constructor invokes _mint to create the initial supply.
Constructor invokes _setupDecimals before minting.
Constructor assigns privileged roles through _setupRole without access checks.
Constructor grants SNAPSHOT_ROLE to the deployer.
Constructor grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the deployer.
_mint credits the recipient balance using checked addition.
_mint increases the total supply via SafeMath addition.
_setupRole delegates to _grantRole, bypassing admin checks by design.
_grantRole mutates the _roles membership mapping.
grantRole resolves the caller via _msgSender for its admin authorization check.
grantRole requires hasRole of the admin role before granting.
grantRole performs the state change through _grantRole.
hasRole reads membership from the _roles mapping.
The role parameter selects which role entry hasRole queries.
The account parameter is the membership subject checked by hasRole.
_setupRole passes the role argument down to the role assignment.
_setupRole passes the account argument down to the role assignment.
snapshot gates execution on hasRole(SNAPSHOT_ROLE, caller).
snapshot calls the internal _snapshot routine after the role check.
The caller identity determines whether the restricted snapshot call succeeds.
snapshot uses the SNAPSHOT_ROLE constant in its authorization check.
_snapshot increments and reads the _currentSnapshotId counter.
_snapshot stores the incremented counter in the currentId local variable.
The transfer hook updates per-account balance snapshots.
The transfer hook updates the total supply snapshot on mint and burn.
_mint triggers the overridden _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_transfer triggers the overridden _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer debits and credits entries in the _balances mapping.
The sender parameter supplies the debited account in _transfer.
sendValue performs a low-level call that hands control to the recipient before returning.
The caller-supplied recipient address becomes the target of sent ether.
The recipient argument directly determines the external call target, enabling reentry.
revokeRole requires hasRole of the admin role before revoking.
revokeRole performs the state change through _revokeRole.
_revokeRole mutates the _roles membership mapping.
revokeRole resolves the caller via _msgSender for its admin authorization check.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor amount parameter is consumed only by the _mint core function.
The constructor decimals parameter is forwarded only to _setupDecimals.
The role bytes32 argument is used only for role membership lookups and grants.
The account argument is used only for role membership checks and grants.
The recipient parameter is the sole target of the ether-sending call in sendValue.
The sender parameter is only meaningful to the _transfer balance updates.
The currentId local variable exists only within the _snapshot core function.
